name: dsh-router
description: Task-aware reasoning-mode router ported from dsh-routing-suite: classifies each user prompt (build / fix / ambiguous) and injects the matching working-style directive, stage workflow discipline, and depth-adaptive guidance near-field.

description_i18n.en: Task-aware reasoning-mode router ported from dsh-routing-suite: classifies each user prompt (build / fix / ambiguous) and injects the matching working-style directive, stage workflow discipline, and depth-adaptive guidance near-field.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 从 dsh-routing-suite 移植的任务感知思维模式路由器：对每条用户消息分类（构建 / 修复 / 歧义），并在近场注入匹配的工作风格指令、阶段工作流纪律与深度自适应引导。
